name: Shuri's Fabricator
oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, create two tapped Vibranium tokens. (They're artifacts with indestructible and "{T}: Add {C}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.")
{6}, {T}: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a finality counter on it would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.)
blocked_sentences: {6}, {T}: Return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a finality counter on it would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.)

needs.what: the finality counter: a permanent with a finality counter on it that would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield is exiled instead, so return_from_graveyard with counters: {finality: 1} carries the replacement
needs.why_existing_wont_do: return_from_graveyard accepts counters, but nothing in the engine gives a 'finality' counter any meaning (no reference anywhere in src); replace_deaths/replace_leaves_battlefield are one-shot ops keyed on objects at resolution, not a counter-driven replacement that persists on the permanent and covers any route to the graveyard
